transformationPolicy: No source values are cleaned, normalized, renamed, reshaped, deduplicated, or sorted. Rows are the exact lines served by the data.gov.sg download API, copied byte for byte in source order; the only permitted change is the documented sampling rule below.
sampling: Rows whose quarter value is one of the latest 60 distinct quarters in the source (15 years), kept in source order with each line copied byte for byte; older quarters are dropped. Nothing else is filtered.
shape: Long quarterly panel, one row per quarter, town and flat type, with a single median monthly rent column. Quarters are strings such as "2021-Q3", flat types are codes such as "3-RM" and "EXEC", and the rent column mixes numbers with two different non-numeric markers, "na" and "-".
